list.heading: Databases
list.subtitle: MySQL databases and their dedicated users.
list.prefixNote: Every database and user carries the owning account's name as a prefix. The names below are exactly what MySQL holds — use them as they are.
list.emptyDescription: Create the first database above. Its password is shown once, when it is created.
list.confirmResetPassword: Set a new password? The current one stops working immediately.
list.confirmDrop: Drop this database? Its tables and its user go with it, and nothing here can bring them back.

form.hint: Lowercase letters and digits only. The account's name is added in front of both.

errors.accountRequired: Choose the account that will own the database.
errors.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters and digits only, up to 30 characters.
errors.dbUserNameInvalid: Use lowercase letters and digits only, up to 30 characters.

credential.title: Database password
credential.warning: This password is shown once. Nothing keeps a copy of it — not this panel, not the server — so it cannot be shown again. Copy it before you close this.
credential.resetHint: If it is lost, reset the password from the list. That is the only way back — there is nothing to recover.
